unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U09: Screen exclusions and notification-based exemptions before enforcement

facts.statement: Section31 exclusions include specified liens, pledges, ships, aircraft in primary, no-security conditional contracts, unpaid-seller rights, specified attachment exclusions, up-to1lakh security, agricultural land, dues below20% principal+interest.31A notified exemptions parliamentary process.

payload.title: Security validity and Act applicability are different questions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Before selecting a SARFAESI measure, screen section 31. Its exclusions include the specified liens, pledges of movables, specified vessel/aircraft interests, contracts that create no security interest, unpaid-seller rights and the stated protected-property situations. It also addresses security for a financial asset not exceeding INR 1 lakh, agricultural land and the stated dues-below-twenty-per-cent condition. Each exclusion needs its own facts; a valid security can have another remedy while being outside this Act.

Section31A also permits class-based exemptions or modifications by the specified notification process. Do not invent an exemption from a lender business name or substitute a generic asset label for factual land-use and legal analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Does exclusion from this Act necessarily cancel the underlying debt?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Applicability and the underlying obligation are separate.

payload.stem_md: An established pledge of movables is valid, but the analyst treats validity alone as proof that SARFAESI must apply. What distinction matters?

options.text_md: Valid security always eliminates statutory exclusions
options.explanation_md: An exclusion can concern a valid security type.

options.text_md: The pledge necessarily becomes an outright transfer of all borrower property
options.explanation_md: That does not follow from pledge validity.

options.text_md: A valid pledge can have a separate remedy while being excluded from this Act
options.explanation_md: Section31 applicability is separate from the existence of the debt/security.

options.text_md: Exclusion proves the borrower has paid
options.explanation_md: Statutory exclusion is not evidence of payment.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Section31 applicability is separate from the existence of the debt/security.

payload.stem_md: A proposed section 31A exemption is inferred only from a lender internal policy. Which evidence is missing?

options.text_md: The applicable governmental notification and its scope
options.explanation_md: An internal policy is not the statutory exemption instrument.
Profit does not establish the notified class.

options.text_md: A declaration that every financial institution is exempt
options.explanation_md: No blanket exemption follows from the given evidence.
Payment convenience does not determine the exemption.

payload.correct_explanation_md: An internal policy is not the statutory exemption instrument.
